Emolument Policy                                                                     薪酬政策
The Group is strictly in compliance with laws and regulations such as the            本集團認真貫徹落實
                                                                                             《勞 動 法》、《勞 動 合 同 法》
Labour Law and the Labour Contract Law, and formulates a remuneration                等 法 律 法 規，並 結 合 企 業 發 展 戰 略、行 業 特
system and incentive policies that suit the actual situation of the enterprise by    點 和 人 工 成 本 支 付 能 力，制 定 切 合 企 業 實 際
combining the development strategy of the enterprise, the characteristics of         的 薪 酬 制 度 和 激 勵 政 策。
the industry and the ability to pay for labour costs.


The Group adopts a differentiated and standardised annual salary system and          本 集 團 根 據 管 理、研 發、生 產 工 人 等 不 同 崗
a non-annual salary system according to different job positions such as              位 序 列，分 別 採 取 差 異 化、規 範 化 的 年 薪 制
management, research and development and production, where the non-                  和 非 年 薪 制 薪 酬 制 度，其 中 非 年 薪 制 又 細 分
annual salary system is subdivided into salary systems such as performance-          為 崗 位 績 效 工 資 制、計（時）件 工 資 制、班 產 量
based salary system, piece-rate (hourly) salary system and shift production daily    日 工 資 制 度 等 薪 酬 制 度。
salary system.


By evaluating the position value of all kinds of personnel and referencing the       通過對各類人員進行崗位價值評估和對標市
market remuneration level, we have set the salary standard with competitive          場 薪 酬 水 平，制 定 具 備 競 爭 優 勢 的 薪 酬 標 準，
advantages by reasonably setting the salary level hierarchy of personnel,            合 理 設 定 人 員 薪 酬 等 級 層 級，確 定 以 崗 定 薪

      Power Co., Ltd. (“Weichai Power”), which comprise the consolidated            （以下簡稱「濰柴動力」）的財務報表，包括
      and the company balance sheets as at 31 December 2023, and the                 2023 年 12 月 31 日 的 合 併 及 公 司 資 產 負 債
      consolidated and the company income statements, the consolidated and           表，2023年度的合併及公司利潤表、合併及
      company cash flow statement and the consolidated and the company               公司現金流量表、合併及公司股東權益變動
      statements of changes in shareholders’ equity for the year then ended,         表以及相關財務報表附註。
      and notes to the financial statements.


      In our opinion, the abovementioned financial statements present fairly, in     我們認為，上述財務報表在所有重大方面按
      all material respects, the consolidated and the company financial position     照企業會計準則的規定編製，公允反映了濰
      of Weichai Power as at 31 December 2023, and the consolidated and              柴動力2023年12月31日的合併及公司財務
      the company financial performance and cash flows of Weichai Power              狀況以及2023年度的合併及公司經營成果和
      for the year 2023 in accordance with Accounting Standards for Business         合併及公司現金流量。
      Enterprises (“ASBEs”).

                 is used to ascertain progress of performance of supply chain                                                                                  應鏈解決方案項目合同的履約進
                 solution services contracts. As at 31 December 2023, some                                                                                     度。截至2023年12月31日，本
                 of the Group’s supply chain solution services contracts were                                                                                  集團部分供應鏈解決方案項目尚
                 still in the process of performance, the transaction price                                                                                    在履行過程中，分攤至尚未履行
                 allocated to the outstanding (or partially unperformed)                                                                                   （或部分未履行）履約義務的交易
                 performance obligations is related to the performance                                                                                         價格與相應供應鏈解決方案項目
                 progress of each supply chain solution services contract, and                                                                                 的履約進度相關，並將於相應供
                 will be recognised as revenue in the future performance                                                                                       應鏈解決方案項目的未來履約期
                 period of each supply chain solution services contracts based                                                                                 內按履約進度確認為收入。

      68. Earnings Per Share (EPS)                                                    68. 每股收益
           The basic EPS is calculated by dividing the net profit of the current         基本每股收益按照歸屬於本公司普通
           period attributable to the ordinary shareholders of the Company by            股股東的當期淨利潤，除以發行在外
           the weighted average number of outstanding ordinary shares.                   普通股的加權平均數計算。


           The calculation of basic EPS is detailed as follows:                          基本每股收益的具體計算如下：


                                                                                        Incurred during         Incurred in
                                                                                               the year       previous year
            Item                                              項目                             本年發生額             上年發生額

            Earnings                                          收益
            Net profit of the current year attributable to    歸屬於本公司普通股股東的
